channel.title: RevenueCat incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from RevenueCat's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Apple partial outage: intermittent errors while processing purchases [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved. We’re now making sure that any purchases affected by the outage are reprocessed.

item.title: Elevated error rates on RevenueCat APIs [resolved]
item.description: Error rates and latency have returned back to normal.

item.title: Webhook delivery is delayed [resolved]
item.description: Webhook delivery latency is still on normal levels and the system is stable. We consider the incident resolved.

item.title: Rico is having issues [resolved]
item.description: Rico continues recovered and stable, we consider the incident resolved.

item.title: App Store Connect undergoing maintenance by Apple [resolved]
item.description: Apple has completed their maintenance.

item.title: Newly created apps error with "The key is not valid or is not compatible with the Bundle ID of your app" [resolved]
item.description: The issue appears to have been resolved on Apple's side. We're seeing keys being correctly validated now.

item.title: Problems connecting to Apple services [resolved]
item.description: All the impacted purchases have been replayed.

item.title: App Store Connect degraded performance [resolved]
item.description: App Store Connect issues are now resolved.

item.title: Cannot connect new Stripe accounts without creating a Stripe Project through the CLI [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved by Stripe and it's now possible to install again the RevenueCat Stripe app through the Stripe Marketplace page.

item.title: Some users unable to login via single-sign-on (SSO) [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Delays in Play Store subscriptions renewals [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Apple Store Kit 2 elevated error rates [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: App Store Connect outage [resolved]
item.description: App Store Connect issues are now resolved.

item.title: Paywall Charts: Conversions not being attributed [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Delays in receipt refresh processing [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Rico unavailable [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Automatic paywall translations unavailable [resolved]
item.description:
This incident has been resolved.
Automatic translations in the Paywall editor are working again. Customers should now be able to generate new paywall translations from the dashboard as expected.

item.title: Elevated Google Play API Error Rate [resolved]
item.description: Our mitigations have eliminated the impact on RevenueCat clients. We will continue tracking the situation and following up with Google on a permanent fix.

item.title: Increased error rate when fetching subscriber information [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Delayed Charts v3 Data [resolved]
item.description: We identified and resolved the issue. Charts v3 data is now up-to-date.

item.title: Increased API error rates due to reduced service capacity. [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Elevated error rates [resolved]
item.description: All systems are now operating normally. Event delivery has fully caught up, and performance has returned to expected levels.

item.title: Increased rate-limit errors on API V2 endpoints [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved.

item.title: Degradation of service [resolved]
item.description:
The underlying infrastructure issue has been addressed, and RevenueCat services are now operating normally again.
Temporary mitigations have been removed as full service has been restored.
We are continuing to monitor the system closely to ensure stability.

item.title: Degraded API Performance [resolved]
item.description:
Earlier today, around 7:20 AM UTC, we had slightly elevated error rates on our API for about 5 minutes due to database maintenance.
The RevenueCat SDK will handle this gracefully, but API users may have noticed a brief increase in errors.

item.title: Scheduled Data Exports delayed for GCP [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: ARR/MRR charts are incorrect for some users [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Ongoing issue dispatching events to webhooks with certain integrations [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved and all failed webhook events have been dispatched.

item.title: Elevated Error Rates. [resolved]
item.description:
From 6:10 to 6:25 UTC, we had slightly higher API error rates due to a database infrastructure issue.
The incident has been resolved.
App using the RevenueCat SDK were not impacted.

item.title: Dashboard: Charts V3 Beta availability issues [resolved]
item.description: Charts V3 Beta is now available again for all users. The underlying infrastructure issue has been resolved. Data processing jobs are still being re-enabled and any data gaps will be backfilled automatically.
